messages:
kevin_platform: FYI I'm trying to lock the telemetry + console contract for GPU metrics that will feed routing/quota decisions for both Hosted + Dedicated pools.
maya_enginfra: +1. We need clear cardinality limits. Per-host and per-pool rollups only, or also per-model / per-customer labels?
sam_ml: We should include per-model token-throughput and per-model queue-length if possible. Routing needs to know model-level backpressure for fallbacks.
jules_product: Product asks for: 95/99 latency p50/p95 for inference path, SM occupancy, GPU mem used, queue depth, and eviction_count. Also boolean flag for 'near capacity' for UI badges.
kevin_platform: Proposed metric names (draft):
```
redwood_gpu_sm_occupancy{pool="hosted|dedicated", gpu_id="..."}  # 0..1
redwood_gpu_memory_bytes_used{pool="...", gpu_type=".."}
redwood_gpu_queue_depth{pool="...", route="/v1/generate", model="gpt-..."}
redwood_gpu_evictions_total{pool="..."}
```
kevin_platform: Questions: 1) sampling interval (1s vs 10s)? 2) label cardinality on route/model/customer? 3) retention (30d vs 90d)?
maya_enginfra: 10s for raw per-GPU metrics is fine; rollups can be 1m. Cardinality: disallow free-form customer label at per-GPU level, allow it on pool+route rollups only. We must cap distinct model ids per node.
sam_ml: For routing we need near-real-time (<=15s) model-level queue depth. If we only have 1m rollups, routing decisions will be stale.
ops-oncall: Also want an alert rule: if sm_occupancy > 0.92 for 2m and queue_depth > 50 -> paged incident.
jules_product: For the console UX: a synthetic "capacity score" 0..100 combining occupancy, mem headroom, and queue slope. Should be derived server-side to keep UI simple.
maya_enginfra: On retention: 30d default, 90d optional for enterprise customers. Storage cost estimate: adding model label to high-cardinality metrics increases cardinality by ~5x.
kevin_platform: API contract for telemetry ingest: push these metric names to /v1/internal/telemetry with timestamp + labels, proto payload. We'll publish a proto soon.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: New schema version v2.1 for gpu_telemetry registered (owner: eng-platform). See /infra/schemas/gpu_telemetry_v2.1
sam_ml: Action items: 1) maya to sketch metric label set + cardinality limits (ETA EOD). 2) kevin to draft proto + sample payload. 3) jules to mock console capacity score widget. 4) ops to propose alert thresholds.
maya_enginfra: I'll post a compact table with metric, labels, retention, scrape interval. Will include Prom/OTLP examples.
kevin_platform: Thanks — let's sync Thu 10am for final sign-off. If anyone can't make it, drop comments on the proto PR.
ops-oncall: noted. :thumbsup
